title: Tribute planning card
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 98 (Tribute planning card (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 98: A spoken tribute: honouring someone who helped us grow. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Opening: Today I want to honour the person who taught me to read: my grandmother.
Quality + anecdote: She is patient: she listened to me read the same book forty times.
Quality + anecdote: She is generous: she shares her food with every neighbour.
Legacy: Because of her, I love stories, and I always share.
Close: JazakAllahu khayran, Nani. Thank you.

panels.title: Speaking skills
points: Steady pace; pause after each quality

keywords.def: words that honour and thank someone
what someone leaves behind for others
a short true story that shows character
how we speak: pace, volume, eye contact

questions.a: For example: Today I want to honour the person who...

questions.q: Core: plan your tribute: opening, two qualities with anecdotes, legacy, close
questions.a: A complete plan on the card

questions.q: Extend: rehearse with a partner (breakout room) and time it (60 to 90 seconds)
Stretch: deliver your tribute to the class

options: She listened to me read the same book forty times.
questions.a: B) She listened to me read the same book forty times.. A specific true story shows patience; repeating the word does not.
